name: outlook-email
description: Read personal Outlook mail and prepare drafts through a local MCP server, using your own Microsoft OAuth application.

interface.shortDescription: Read Outlook mail and prepare drafts
interface.longDescription: Community integration using Softeria's open-source Microsoft 365 MCP server locally. Connects directly to Microsoft Graph with your own Microsoft Entra application. Configure any personal Outlook, Hotmail, or Live mailbox locally. Requires Node.js 22+ and Microsoft OAuth setup.
defaultPrompt: Triage inbox, summarize thread, or draft reply or forward
